<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_SupplierOnboarding" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/supplier-onboarding">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_SupplierOnboarding" name="Supplier Onboarding" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_SupplierNeed" name="Need for new supplier identified">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IssueRFP" name="Issue request for proposals (RFP)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveProposals" name="Receive supplier proposals">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateProposals" name="Evaluate proposals by cost, quality and delivery time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VerificationSplit" name="Site visit or interview needed?" default="Flow_SkipVerification">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_VerificationYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SkipVerification</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SiteVisitOrInterview" name="Conduct site visits and/or interviews with suppliers">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_VerificationYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VerificationMerge" name="Verification completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SkipVerification</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AnalyzeAndSelect" name="Analyze proposals and select supplier">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateContract" name="Negotiate contract terms">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SignContract" name="Sign contract">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OnboardSupplier" name="Onboard supplier">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ExecuteContract" name="Execute contract">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_SupplierOnboarded" name="Supplier onboarded and contract executed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_SupplierNeed" targetRef="Task_IssueRFP"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_IssueRFP" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProposals"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveProposals" targetRef="Task_EvaluateProposals"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateProposals" targetRef="Gateway_VerificationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VerificationYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_VerificationSplit" targetRef="Task_SiteVisitOrInterview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SkipVerification" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_VerificationSplit" targetRef="Gateway_VerificationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_SiteVisitOrInterview" targetRef="Gateway_VerificationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Gateway_VerificationMerge" targetRef="Task_AnalyzeAndSelect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_AnalyzeAndSelect" targetRef="Task_NegotiateContract"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateContract" targetRef="Task_SignContract"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_SignContract" targetRef="Task_OnboardSupplier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_OnboardSupplier" targetRef="Task_ExecuteContract"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_ExecuteContract" targetRef="EndEvent_SupplierOnboarded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
